finalText:
Migration's done. 12 files moved from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The only spot still on the old call is `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone — its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local edits get silently lost there. Worth flagging to whoever owns that vendor sync if the old call ever actually gets dropped.
